_comment: Peer-issued TCT (RFC-AITP-0005). On the wire a v0.2 TCT is an opaque compact JWS string (header.payload.signature, typ 'aitp-tct+jwt'). The token below is a PLACEHOLDER: the header segment is real base64url of {"alg":"EdDSA","typ":"aitp-tct+jwt"}, but the payload and signature segments are human-readable stand-ins and will fail cryptographic verification. _decoded_claims shows what the payload segment would decode to. For a real, verifiable token see schemas/conformance/known-answer/signed-examples/tct/.
